scientific_specification.width_selection: Selected from SON raw EOF1 SST-level R2 in Stage 3, not from SST-organization correlations.
scientific_specification.detrending: Remove linear trends separately from the raw PC, SST, and organization series; do not recalculate EOFs.

provenance_limits: Historical Stage 5 execution metadata, the exact command, and the executed-source hash were not archived.
Matching outputs alone do not establish the historical source or command.
PNG metadata support DPI 250 but do not identify the original command.
Stage 5 writes four CSV files and two PDF/PNG pairs; it does not write NetCDF, metadata JSON, or PC-group tables.
S5/S6 use Stage 4 annual tables directly; supplementary check tables are not Stage 5 outputs.
